title: Context is a voting chamber
summary: Summary withheld: an Opus review found that the machine-written summary did not match the post. Read the original post.

quotes.text: Most of a long conversation genuinely does bill at that cache-read rate, because most of it is being read, not reprocessed.
quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies the cost economics: caching makes long sessions manageable financially, costing only one-tenth of input rates for reused context

quotes.text: Anything else still means summarizing what matters yourself, and starting over.
quotes.why_it_matters: Instructs that telling agents to ignore information adds new voters rather than removing old ones, making manual summaries and fresh sessions the only effective solution
